description: Building a narrative and possible animations around equipment left on the moon. I am skilled in Front End Development and Back End Development.
summary: This project lists a set of curated equipment and other items left on the moon. The home page gives a summary list with thumbnail pictures. Selecting an item will bring up a detail page that has a link to an existing Wikipedia Page as well as a link that brings up any related material from Nasa's Image Library. A zoomable/moveable map of the moon showing various items left on the moon is also displayed. All links are live and the entire site is usable.
details: The site uses a combination of Python, Flask, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQLLite to show the site. It runs on two html template FLASK pages: index.html, item.html. Additionally, CoPilot and Gemini AI engines were used to generate or provide example code. All thumbnails pictures are from Nasa's image library and/or Wikipedia sources.
